assessmentQuestionVersion.name: PSE_RiskAssessment_Q1
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Inherent risk of service type (select based on the highest risk or most complex service offered at the facility)
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: High risk: Services that intentionally break the skin, accesses non-intact skin/mucous membrane, or provide invasive access to a body cavity. Failures in infection prevention and other control measures pose a high risk of transmission of bloodborne, or other serious infections, or injury. Moderate risk: Services that do not intentionally break the skin, but that may result in unintentional contact with non-intact skin, mucous membrane or blood/bodily fluid, or that may result in burns, irritation, or other physical injuries. Non-invasive/low risk: Services with minimal risk of communicable disease transmission or injury.
